notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Repeat.

uses.name: Walking Ballista
uses.cardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it
